title: Understanding Information Preferences, Risk Perceptions, and Tradeoffs When Making Decisions About Multi-cancer Early Detection Tests
official: Investigating Information Preferences, Risk Perceptions, and Tradeoffs in Multi-Cancer Early Detection Decisions: A Randomized Vignette Trial
summary: The goal of this clinical trial is to learn what people's informational preferences and risk perceptions are in regards to the use of multi-cancer early detection (MCED) tests. Participants will be asked to review three informational factors about MCED tests and complete a survey about their intentions to use an MCED test. Some participants will also be asked to complete an interview.

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Aged 40-74
* Speak English or Spanish

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior diagnosis of cancer (with the exception of non-melanoma skin cancers)
* Previous use of a Multi-Cancer Early Detection (MCED) test.
